answer_text:
Here's a breakdown of how long sliced American cheese lasts, depending on the type and storage:

---

## 🧀 Sliced American Cheese Shelf Life

### **Individually Wrapped Slices (e.g., Kraft Singles) — Unopened**
Processed American cheese tends to last around **1–2 months unopened**. The expiration date printed on packages is generally about **five to six months** after the cheese is produced. Unopened slices can last up to **two months beyond the printed date**, though you should toss the cheese once it starts looking dried-out.

### **Deli-Sliced American Cheese (from the deli counter)**
After sliced American deli cheese is purchased, it may be refrigerated for **2 to 3 weeks** — the "sell-by" date on the package may expire during that storage period, but the cheese will remain safe to use after the sell-by date if it has been properly stored.

If you purchase freshly sliced deli cheese, use it within **5–7 days** of purchase for best quality.

### **After Opening a Package**
Generally, opened processed American cheese slices last around **2 to 4 weeks** in the fridge if kept properly sealed and stored at consistent temperatures.

---

## ❄️ Freezing
To further extend the shelf life of sliced American cheese, you can freeze it — place the cheese in the freezer before the number of days shown for refrigerator storage has elapsed. Well-wrapped and stored American cheese will be good in the freezer for **up to 10 months**. Sliced American cheese that has been defrosted can be kept for an additional **3 to 4 days** in the refrigerator; however, frozen cheese may become crumbly and lose some flavor, so thawed cheese is best suited to cooked dishes like sauces, soups, and casseroles.

---

## ⚠️ Signs It's Gone Bad
Monitor for signs of spoilage such as **discoloration, bad odor, slimy texture, or mold**. The Mayo Clinic warns that mold can easily penetrate through soft cheeses, as well as any pre-sliced cheese — so if you find that one slice has spoiled, you should throw them all out.

---

## 🌡️ Room Temperature
At room temperature, even processed cheese can only hold up for about **two hours**.

**Quick Summary Table:**

| Type | Refrigerator | Freezer |
|---|---|---|
| Individually wrapped (unopened) | Up to 2 months past printed date | Up to 10 months |
| Deli-sliced (freshly cut) | 2–3 weeks | Up to 10 months |
| After opening | 2–4 weeks | Up to 10 months |
| After thawing | 3–4 days | — |
